name: mexican tofu fritters
instructions:
The MEXICAN version of the european calamari plate ([[tofu-calamari]]) — same crispy-tofu structure, mexican accompaniments instead of tapas. (Renamed from 'tofu street tacos' — fritters is more accurate; the tortilla is one serving route, not the dish.)

=== THE TOFU (SAME STRUCTURE AS TOFU CALAMARI, MEXICAN COAT) ===

- SUPER FIRM / EXTRA FIRM tofu (no pressing — same rule as the calamari; firm tofu clashing there, clashing here), HAND-SHREDDED for fractal edges.
- The coat: ONION + GARLIC POWDER, CORN/POTATO STARCH, SALT — but CUT THE STARCH WITH A SUBSTANTIAL AMOUNT OF CORNMEAL / MASA HARINA, plus CHILI POWDER (NEW MEXICAN, GUAJILLO).
- Maybe CHIPOTLE POWDER for heat (want to try). NOT ancho or pasilla — I don't think they'd work here (clashing).
- Toss in oil, bake at ~425°F until crisp and browned (the calamari chassis).

=== THE SPREAD ===

- SALSAS: [[salsa-bruja]], [[sauce-andalouse]] (would work here too), [[crema-mexicana]].
- BEANS: [[refried-beans]] and/or [[mexican-black-beans]].
- CHEESE: monterrey jack / feta / cheddar.
- TORTILLAS.
- CILANTRO.
- SLICED AVOCADO.
- LIME.

EATING IT: fritters with the spread — taco-style in a tortilla, or straight off the plate with beans, salsa, crema, cheese, cilantro, avocado, lime.
notes:
=== THE CONCEPT — CALAMARI PLATE GONE MEXICAN ===

Same crispy-tofu engine as [[tofu-calamari]] (no-press tofu, hand-shredded, starch + onion/garlic powder, hot oven), swapped from the iberian tapas register to the mexican street-taco register. The structural change is in the coat: the starch gets CUT WITH A SUBSTANTIAL AMOUNT OF CORNMEAL / MASA HARINA (the corn flavor is the mexican move) plus NEW MEXICAN + GUAJILLO chili powder.

=== THE CHILE LINE ===

- IN: new mexican + guajillo chili powder (the bright red earthy end).
- MAYBE: chipotle powder for heat — want to try.
- OUT: ancho and pasilla — I don't think they'd work here (the dark raisiny end; clashing).

=== WHY I LIKE IT — NO OBVIOUS MEAT ANALOGUE ===

There isn't an obvious meat recipe that combines the FRIED CORN + VINEGAR/CREAM SALSA + PROTEIN flavors — would you deep fry shredded pork and corn? Like [[chard-pickle-pasta]], this is a vegan/tofu-native build: the combination only exists because the tofu can take the corn-starch coat. (That said: PORK SHOULDER is a want-to-try — the one meat that might actually answer the question.)

=== WANT TO TRY — THE SWEET DIRECTION ===

POWDERED CINNAMON in the coat, and a DESSERT SALSA to dip — the fried-corn chassis could swing sweet (churro logic).

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[tofu-calamari]]: the european original — same tofu rules (super/extra firm no-press, firm tofu clashing), different condiment shelf.
- [[salsa-bruja]] / [[crema-mexicana]] / [[sauce-andalouse]]: the salsa shelf, all standalone recipes.
- [[refried-beans]] / [[mexican-black-beans]]: the bean layer, both standalone recipes.
why_i_like_this_recipe: There isn't an obvious meat recipe that combines the fried corn + vinegar/cream salsa + protein flavors — would you deep fry shredded pork and corn? The tofu build gets somewhere meat doesn't go.
original_chef: Mine — the tofu-calamari structure moved to the mexican register.
